📚 Hard vocab word #41: FORBEARANCE

forbearance (noun): patient self-control; restraint.

✅ In a sentence: The teacher showed great forbearance with the disruptive class.
✅ Similar: patience, restraint, tolerance
✅ Remember it: Verb: forbear = to hold back from doing something.
